description: Register a XeroResource wrapping the Xero Accounting API. OAuth2 refresh-token flow (client_id/client_secret/refresh_token posted as form fields, not Basic auth). Every request carries an Xero-tenant-id header -- the tenant id is auto-discovered via GET /connections unless supplied explicitly. Exposes a generic request().

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

client_id_env_var.label: Client ID Env Var
client_id_env_var.description: Env var with OAuth2 Client ID

client_secret_env_var.label: Client Secret Env Var
client_secret_env_var.description: Env var with OAuth2 Client Secret

refresh_token_env_var.label: Refresh Token Env Var
refresh_token_env_var.description: Env var with OAuth2 Refresh Token

tenant_id.label: Tenant ID
tenant_id.description: Xero tenant (org) id. If unset, auto-discovered via GET /connections (first connected tenant).

name: Xero Resource
